aulowenn1.m: Halt! Do not come any closer. The contents of these crates is property of Feygard.
r: I mean you no harm. Who are you?
Sure. I'll just stay right here. Who are you?

aulowenn10.m: I have two theories. My first thought is that some of the local creatures that we've been having problems with here might have captured them, or even killed them. I know for a fact that some were killed by the creatures, since we even buried some of my men to the east of here, but I am not certain of the others.

aulowenn11.m: The creatures in these woods are intelligible, but fierce. Luckily, we've been able to kill them off before they've been able to spew their foul lies. There are still a few of them around though.

aulowenn12.m: My second theory is that the madman that we are looking for must have done something to them. Maybe the madman has smeared some of his madness onto them.

aulowenn13.m: Regardless, there isn't much that I am able to do here. I need to guard these crates.

aulowenn14.m: Also, I do hope that those creatures that seem to live here don't return. They've been a real pest.
r: Anything I can do to help?

aulowenn15.m: Oh yes, would you? There is one thing you could do.

aulowenn16.m: As I mentioned, some of my men were killed by the local creatures here. We buried them to the east of here.

aulowenn17.m: I haven't been there for a few days now, but last I visited the graves, there was one of those foul creatures standing over the graves.

aulowenn18.m: I've seen that particular creature there before, it seems to be haunting the graves of my fellow men.

aulowenn19.m: Of course, it must be up to no good. I would like your help in either removing or defeating that thing.
r: So, you want me to go visit the graves to the east and defeat whatever creature is there?
What are you doing out here?

aulowenn20.m: Yes, that's it. I should also warn you that those creatures are intelligible, so I would urge you to act quickly when encountering it, before it can spew its foul lies.
r: Sounds easy enough. I'll do it.
Great, more blood for my sword. I'll do it.
Anything to help a fellow Feygard friend.
I don't think I should get involved in this.
I'll go visit the graves, but I can't promise that I'll kill anyone.

aulowenn21.m: Good. Return here once you are done.

aulowenn21a.m: Glory to Feygard. Return here once you are done.

aulowenn21b.m: You do as you wish. I'll be here regardless.

aulowenn3.m: I'm guarding these crates. That's what I do. At least until my company gets back from their scouting party.

aulowenn4.m: Oh I hope they do get back. Come to think of it, they have been away for quite some time now.

aulowenn5.m: I sure hope they are well. Unlike the others...

aulowenn6.m: In my squad, we were a band of six guards that, together with other squads, were sent out here to find a dangerous madman that takes his refuge somewhere in the nearby hills around here.

aulowenn7.m: But something started to happen once we got here. Some of my fellow guards started acting ... odd.

aulowenn8.m: I don't know if it was just me imagining things or if something truly happened to them. Anyway, one by one, we started to get fewer and fewer.

aulowenn9.m: Some of my men were killed by the creatures that live in these woods, some ran away by themselves and some have never come back from their scouting trips.
r: What do you think has happened to them?

aulowenn_k0.m: Excellent. Maybe now my brethren can rest peacefully. Thank you so much for helping me.

aulowenn_k1.m: In return, you are very welcome to use my bed to rest whenever you wish.

aulowenn_ms0.m: Hello again. Were you successful in defeating that beast?
r: What was I supposed to do again?
Not yet. I'll do it soon enough though.
I don't think I should get involved in this.
I'll go visit the graves, but I can't promise that I'll kill anyone.
I met Tiqui by those graves. He had an interesting tale to tell.

aulowenn_tq0.m: You actually listened to it? Please, indulge me, what lies did it have you believe?
r: He told me that you have been killing off his kin.

aulowenn_tq1.m: Of course we have! They've been attacking us, and we've taken precautions by hunting them so they can't kill more of us.

aulowenn_tq2.m: To think that they believe they have a chance against the forces of Feygard. Hah! We will cut them down like sheep once the reinforcements get here.
r: I should leave before there is more bloodshed.
I don't like your tone. They haven't done anything to you.
I was also asked to take care of you, and I intend to do just that.

aulowenn_tq3.m: Hah! Take care of me? That will be the day.
r: You will be no match for me.
I should leave before there is more bloodshed.

aulowenn_tq4.m: Hah! See, there are those lies that I told you about. They. Attacked. Us. Get it?
r: You will be no match for me.
I should leave before there is more bloodshed.

aulowenn_wb0.m: Welcome back my friend. Thank you for helping me defeat that foul creature that was haunting the grave of my fellow guards.

lodar13_rest.10: In the maze of green vines east of the Duleian road, I met a guard named Aulowenn from Feygard, guarding some crates. She told me that she was part of a larger group of guards searching for a madman that supposedly hides somewhere in the nearby hills, but that the other guards are now dead or missing.
lodar13_rest.11: Aulowenn requested my help in defeating a monster that haunts the grave of her fellow guards to the east. She warned me that the foul beast will most likely try to trick me into listening to its story.
lodar13_rest.20: I have met the creature that Aulowenn spoke of.
lodar13_rest.22: I listened to the creature's story. Its name is Tiqui, and he is the head of his clan. Apparently, the guards have been ruthlessly killing off his kin. He asked me to kill the guard for him, as revenge for what they have done.
lodar13_rest.24: The creature tried to trick me into listening to its story.
lodar13_rest.30: I attacked the creature before it could spew out more of its foul lies.
lodar13_rest.40: Aulowenn thanked me for bringing peace to the grave of her fallen companions by killing the creature.
lodar13_rest.41: Tiqui was overjoyed that I helped him kill the guard for him. He promised that if we ever run into each other again, he'd help me somehow.
lodar13_rest.60: I am now able to use Aulowenn's bed whenever I wish to rest.
lodar13_rest.65: I will not be able to resolve the conflict between Aulowenn and her attacker.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
